name: Wetlands
summary: Fog and fighting shape life in the Wetlands, between Khaz Modan and Baradin Bay. Dwarven wars and orc invasions scarred the marsh, a rugged buffer between Ironforge and Lordaeron. Menethil Harbor keeps the Alliance connected to distant shores, amid Dragonmaw orcs, murlocs, and gnolls.

sections.title: A Land of Water and Ruin
sections.body: Below the Stonewrought Dam, cold marshland lies under gray skies and heavy fog. Once home to thriving dwarven settlements, the Wetlands now hold sunken stone ruins, sodden bogs, and treacherous mires. You can enter by the narrow pass at Dun Algaz, coming north from Loch Modan, or cross the arches of the Thandol Span from the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: The Scars of Grim Batol
sections.body: Grim Batol looms over the eastern swamp, its halls once held by the Wildhammer dwarves. Defiled during the War of the Three Hammers, the stronghold became a redoubt for the Dragonmaw clan during the Second War. When the red dragonflight broke free of orcish captivity, its fiery vengeance shattered the orcish forces and laid waste to the slopes. Red wyrmkin guard the Dragonmaw Gates, while feral Dragonmaw survivors live in scattered hill camps and harass travelers across the swamp.

sections.title: Port of the West Coast
sections.body: Menethil Harbor occupies the rim of Baradin Bay, carrying Alliance trade and supplies through Khaz Modan. The port honors King Terenas Menethil II and links the Eastern Kingdoms with Kalimdor. Ships sail to Theramore Isle and, by way of Southshore, to Auberdine. Dwarven-built defenses protect the harbor, but coastal murlocs, swamp creatures, and raiders threaten vessels in the rocky channels.

sections.title: Besieged Frontiers
sections.body: War reaches the Wetlands from several directions. In the north, Dark Iron dwarves led by the warlock Balgaras the Foul sabotaged the Thandol Span and seized Dun Modr, cutting off overland supply trains. Mosshide gnolls roam the central fens and threaten even Rethiel the Greenwarden, an ancient protector. Rogue orc warbands, Dark Iron infiltrators, and cursed shipwrecks keep the swamp dangerous, and its defenders must stay alert.

faq.q: How do I travel to the Wetlands on foot?
faq.answer: From Loch Modan, take the mountain pass through Dun Algaz north into the Wetlands. Travelers coming from the north can cross the Thandol Span from the Arathi Highlands. Hostile Dragonmaw orcs and Dark Iron dwarves contest both routes.

faq.q: Where do the boats at Menethil Harbor go?
aliases: where does the boat go in wetlands
faq.answer: One ship sails south to Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. The other calls at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills, then crosses the Great Sea to Auberdine on the shores of Darkshore.

faq.q: What is Grim Batol and why is it guarded?
aliases: why are there dragons at grim batol
faq.answer: Grim Batol is an ancient dwarven fortress abandoned after the War of the Three Hammers and later occupied by the Dragonmaw clan. After the Second War, the freed red dragonflight drove out the orcs and sealed the mountain. Red dragonspawn and wyrmkin patrol the Dragonmaw Gates to keep intruders from the cursed halls.

Dun Modr, a northern dwarven stronghold guarding the Thandol Span, was recently overrun by Dark Iron dwarves led by Balgaras the Foul. Survivors under Rhag Garmason hold an embattled camp nearby and fight to reclaim the town.
Rethiel the Greenwarden is an ancient bog beast who lives in the Wetlands' Green Belt. He seeks travelers' help against aggressive Mosshide gnolls and diseased Fen Creepers so the marsh can recover.

faq.q: Where did all the orcs in the swamp come from?
aliases: why are there orcs in wetlands
faq.answer: The swamp's orcs belong to the Dragonmaw clan, which fortified Grim Batol during the Second War. After the freed red dragonflight devastated them, survivors fled into the swamp and hills, where they still raid roads and travelers.

angles.text: For dwarves, the Wetlands carries the loss of Dun Modr, the tragedy of Grim Batol, and the ongoing work of defending King Magni's northern trade route.
For the Alliance, Menethil Harbor is the chief deep-water route across the Great Sea, linking the eastern kingdoms with outposts in Kalimdor.
As a miner, you can find rich mineral veins in the hills and caverns of Thelgen Rock, including rare Incendicite ore sought by dwarven miners and engineers.
